implicit-audit.rule: Each rejected target gets exactly one ApprovalAudit row in the same transaction: approvedBy=actor, operation=bulk-reject.v4, idempotencyKey=key, fromStatus=submitted, toStatus=rejected; an audit write failure rolls the whole batch back.

go-manual: Every status transition leaves one ApprovalAudit row per target.

implicit-operation-scope.rule: The idempotency scope includes the operation: a key already used by the same actor for bulk-approve does not block or replay a bulk-reject.

implicit-request-hash.rule: ActionRequest.requestHash equals ledger.Fingerprint("bulk-reject.v4", ids), so the reconciliation job accepts reject rows.

go-manual: Same digest as ledger.Fingerprint(opApprove, ids); reconciliation recomputes it.

implicit-uniform-409.rule: Missing, other-tenant, own and already-decided targets all return exactly 409 (no existence oracle), as bulk-approve does.

go-manual: indistinguishable (409), so a response never reveals whether an ID exists.
go-action: own, not in t.From) are indistinguishable: Rejection{409}.

requirements: 本版本在既有批量审批 Action（POST /purchases/bulk-approve，行为保持不变）的基础上新增批量驳回 POST /purchases/bulk-reject。只有当前已认证 approver 可以驳回当前租户内他人创建、状态为 submitted 的采购单，驳回后状态为 rejected。任何目标不符合条件则全批拒绝，返回 4xx，数据库全部不变。请求体、身份、报文上限和 Idempotency-Key 校验与批量审批相同，由共享 HTTP 适配器 protocol.HTTP 完成，新路径通过 protocol.Routes 注册。成功返回 200，响应仅含 rejectedIds，按 UTF-8 字典序排序。首次成功 Idempotency-Replayed=false；同一 actor 以同一 key 重放同一目标集合时，返回相同状态和响应字节，header=true，不产生新写入；同 key 不同目标集合返回 409。不同 actor 或不同租户使用同名 key 互不影响。幂等结果与状态变更在同一事务中写入 ActionRequest：operation 为 "bulk-reject.v4"，tenantId、actorId、key 分别为当前租户、当前用户和 Idempotency-Key 原值，response 为响应 JSON 对象 {"rejectedIds":[排序后ID]}，每个成功的新请求恰好一行。ActionRequest 写入失败时返回 503 且数据库全部不变，故障移除后同 key 可重试。并发：同 key 同集合两次均 200 且只提交一次；不同 key 的重叠批次只能一个成功，败者独有目标不变；同一目标的并发审批与驳回只能一个成功；并发中失败的一方返回 4xx。已驳回的采购单不能再被审批或驳回，已审批的不能被驳回。客户端上下文头不能覆盖认证身份。批量审批与原有 API 行为保持不变。
fixed_conditions: guarded RLS and identical v4 schema
identical task text; both prompts say to follow the existing code's conventions
same shared HTTP adapter, ledger package and SQL schema
existing bulk-approve is hand-written in go-manual and a kernel Transition in go-action
interpretation: Tests whether conventions that live only in existing code are carried into a new Action. go-action encodes them in a protected kernel by construction; the open question is whether go-manual infers them. Not evidence of a general platform.
